analysis: This 70-74-year-old male with ECOG 1 and multiple grade 1 adverse events (fatigue, dysgeusia, nausea) shows preserved functional status but accumulating comorbidity burden. The development of grade 3 pneumonia and peripheral edema signals increased vulnerability. Frailty risk is moderate; goals of care should emphasize symptom management and maintaining independence.
